comments.author: Suntion
comments.body_html:
Regarding Fika Compatibility:

  • Match Recording: Logically compatible, but lacks test data.
  • Command Dialog: Logically compatible, but lacks test data.
  • WebUI: Logically compatible with no test data; however, it may be accessible by clients. Due to the newly added match deletion feature, please ensure all players in the multiplayer session are trusted to prevent potential data loss.

This statement was released in version v0.6.10.

comments.author: Suntion
comments.body_html:
This error typically occurs in the following scenarios:

Scenario 1: During normal gameplay, occasionally at the end of a match, no started match data is found (this happens because SPT sometimes processes the same request twice, leaving no data for the second attempt).

Scenario 2 (more common than Scenario 1): HandleRaidStart fails to record the match start data properly. In this case, the logs should contain the specific error details.
